checksLog.argument: The six consecutive integer factors include an even integer, so w_r is even. This is a divisibility argument for all r, not a finite sample.

argument.reason: Even increasing integer exponents; |x|<1 tends to 0; |x|>1 unbounded.
(n+2)**log(x) has a finite limit precisely for log(x)<=0.
x is nonzero; exp(2*x) is positive and less than 1 precisely when x<0.
|5t| dominates |2t|; negative endpoint oscillates, positive endpoint leaves 1.
All log arguments positive for x>=-1; x=-1 oscillates, x>1 grows.
